settled.decided: python3 -m unittest from the invoicer folder, as tests/__init__.py gives it; all 86 tests passed before any change and after each one.

settled.about: how the check was run on the deliverable's files
settled.decided: lefthook run pre-commit with a --file for each .py file of invoicer/ and tests/ and for docs/print-an-invoice.md, since --all-files reaches only tracked files and most of these aren't committed yet. It gave 33 blocking findings before and none after, with exit 0. The suggestions it lists don't stop a commit and stay, as the decision asks for the check to pass and for the messages to stay the same.

settled.about: cell texts quoted in test docstrings
settled.decided: Each literal cell text, header, or tab name in a test docstring is written in backticks in place of double quotes, as the docstrings already write commands and messages. Its exact text, spaces included, stays, and the comma or period after it stays outside it. Done in every test docstring of tests/test_sheet.py and tests/test_command.py, so they quote one way; no string of the code changed.

settled.about: the rate range in the docstrings
settled.decided: 'a rate above 0 and below 1' becomes 'a rate over 0 and under 1', the same range that invoicer/__main__.py:66 refuses, 0 < percent < 1.

settled.about: the least rate in a test docstring
settled.decided: 'the least rate above 0' becomes 'the least rate over 0'.

settled.about: a price with more than two decimals
settled.decided: The example with an ellipsis becomes the 33.3333333333333 that the formula =100/3 stores, the same case written whole.
'the 27th' becomes 'column number 27', the same column, AA.

settled.about: the guide's sentence before the example invoice
settled.decided: 'For the example above' becomes 'such as this one for `acme.ods` at 19 %', naming the command just shown, so the colleague knows which run the invoice belongs to.
